name: Glue Seal, Greater
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bard 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one object/2 levels or 1 5-ft. square/2 levels; see text

This spell functions as glue seal, except as noted here.

When you use this spell to cover a solid surface with sticky glue, the 5-foot squares must form a continuous area, each part of which must be within the spell’s range. When you use this spell to create a sticky coating on items, no two of the targeted items can be more than 30 feet apart. You cannot target both items and surfaces with a single casting of this spell.
